mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the major aspect of commercial transaction under the contract of affreightment alongside the contract by Bill of lading because most times they work hand in hand."
Charter-party is the major aspect of commercial transaction under the contract of affreightment alongside the contract by Bill of lading because most times they work hand in hand.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as an intentional change in the geographical route of the voyage as contracted."
Deviation is defined as an intentional change in the geographical route of the voyage as contracted.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a dynamic and exciting area of law."
Commercial law is a dynamic and exciting area of law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the transportation of goods from one destination to another by road."
Carriage of goods by land is the transportation of goods from one destination to another by road.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major duty of the buyer as well as the duty to accept the goods as transacted after the seller fulfills its duty in the transaction."
Payment for the goods is a major duty of the buyer as well as the duty to accept the goods as transacted after the seller fulfills its duty in the transaction.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the implied terms contained in section 4 of the Hire Purchase Act, 1965 and in section 12-15 of the Sale of Goods Act, 1893."
Among outstanding examples are the implied terms contained in section 4 of the Hire Purchase Act, 1965 and in section 12-15 of the Sale of Goods Act, 1893.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the insurer of the safety of the goods carried and therefore he is liable for any damage to or loss of them, whether occasioned by his negligence or not."
A common carrier is the insurer of the safety of the goods carried and therefore he is liable for any damage to or loss of them, whether occasioned by his negligence or not.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the oldest systems of carriage of goods in commercial transactions."
Carriage of goods by road is one of the oldest systems of carriage of goods in commercial transactions.

______ is an immediate, voluntary and gratuitous transfer of any property from one person to another.
gift
A gift is an immediate, voluntary and gratuitous transfer of any property from one person to another.
______ is a situation where the goods are either damaged or lost without the fault of any party.
Frustration
Frustration is a situation where the goods are either damaged or lost without the fault of any party.

Communication in this sense means actual notification to the offeror or to his agent duly authorized to receive an acceptance.
______ means to transfer "dominion" i.e. the highest possible rights enjoyed by the owner of goods to the buyer.
concept of transfer
The concept of transfer means to transfer "dominion" i.e. the highest possible rights enjoyed by the owner of goods to the buyer.

______ may be defined as a definite undertaking or promise, made by one party with the intention that it shall become binding on the party making it as soon as it is accepted by the party to whom it is addressed.
offer

An offer may be defined as a definite undertaking or promise, made by one party with the intention that it shall become binding on the party making it as soon as it is accepted by the party to whom it is addressed.
______ is a right to retain possession of goods until payment or tender of the whole price is made.
lien
A lien is a right to retain possession of goods until payment or tender of the whole price is made.
